title: Fourier mass on a finite family
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$ and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$. If the variance of $f$ under the uniform distribution on the sign cube is at least $1/2$, then the sum of the squares of its Fourier coefficients over the family consisting of the nonempty subsets of the Friedgut coordinates of $f$ at accuracy $1/8$ having size at most the corresponding Friedgut degree is at least $1/4$.
hypotheses_covered: The uniform variance of $f$ is at least $1/2$
